Welcome to Wordwell.

Choose a provider, enter your API key, and connect to see its models. Select a model and save to enable AI, or continue learning manually.

The selected model must support images to review charts and diagrams.

For compatible APIs, turn this off only if your endpoint rejects JSON mode. Wordwell still requires a valid JSON answer.

One choice for both tools.

Your saved provider powers vocabulary autofill and Writing feedback. Switching takes effect immediately.

Keep your own setup

Each provider remembers its model and endpoint. Saved keys appear masked. Show reveals the current key; Change key lets you enter a replacement. Connect and save to activate it.

Local credentials

Keys are stored in the private local file data/ai-settings.json, in plain text. This file is excluded from Git and SQLite backups. Keep it private when copying the project.

Using a local proxy

CLIProxyAPI must already be running and connected to your provider. Use its client API key and the model alias it exposes. Selecting a proxy does not grant model access by itself.

Free and local options

Gemini offers a limited free API tier where available. Ollama runs a downloaded model on your computer without a cloud API key. Provider prices, quotas, and model availability still apply.

KEEP YOUR PRACTICE SAFE

A copy for safekeeping.

Your data saves to data/wordwell.sqlite in the project folder.

Download your database

A complete SQLite copy includes vocabulary, review progress, and your saved Writing draft, image, and AI feedback.

To restore it, stop Wordwell, keep a copy of the current database, then replace data/wordwell.sqlite with your backup and start Wordwell again.

Vocabulary JSON backups

Export vocabulary and review progress, or restore an existing Wordwell JSON backup. Combining keeps newer entries; replacing affects vocabulary only.

Local saving and browser migration

The database belongs to this project and is shared by browsers using its local server. Clearing browser data will not remove SQLite data. On the first refresh after this update, your old browser notebook and Writing draft are copied into SQLite. Original browser data is retained for recovery.
